title: System invariant: every open position always has BOTH brackets (SL and TP); nothing removes a bracket, only moves it - enforce on every order path, with a runtime guard
note: OPERATOR 2026-10-26 ~19:02Z (manager relay), verbatim: "in general, every trade always must have BOTH brackets, not related to this skill. Claude can move the brackets, but nothing is supposed to remove brackets". Audit by lane LTR-ALL-ACTIONS (read-only sweep at main 577ed9c1; lines from a delegated read, two spot-checked by the lane: execute.py:505-521 and order_monitor.py:12244-12277 MEASURED, the rest INFERRED from that read and to be re-read before fixing). EXISTING GUARDS: entry gate src/units/accounts/execute.py:505-521 (refuses a non-reduce live order without SL>0 AND TP>0); prop ticket gate src/prop/prop_executor.py:364 (both); prop naked check prop_executor.py:3343 + _repair_or_flatten ~2939 (both, but TP only when the journal has one; fallback flattens); order_monitor.py:13654 naked flag (SL or TP null) but _attempt_naked_autoprotect ~9827 re-arms only when both known, IB-only; broker sweeps (order_monitor ~10541 Alpaca, ~11327 IB, ~12875 Bybit) re-arm SL only, IB TP alert-only; protection_reassert.py needs_both_legs; CI check_tp_doctrine.py is config-only (TP reality, ratchet), nothing checks runtime presence of both. PATHS THAT CAN LEAVE A POSITION WITHOUT A BRACKET: (1) order_monitor.py:12244-12278 _bybit_top_up_partial_sl places an SL-only leg (tp=None, docstring: 'a missing take-profit is not a risk'); (2) execute.py ~3245-3302 IB modify_open_order with unknown cur_tp re-arms stop-only OCA after cancelling the old group (and symbol-wide cancel without trade_id); (3) ib_client.py ~1649-1690 place_protective places only the legs given, cancel-before-place; (4) the monitor sweeps never re-arm a missing TP on IB/Alpaca/Bybit; (5) Bybit spot execute.py ~1590/3120: no exchange-side SL/TP at all (monitor market-close exits); (6) cancel-after-flat order_monitor.py ~2144/2324 (callers ~4135,7287,7365,8027,8330,15206; symbol-wide ~4503/4800): a wrong flat read leaves a live position naked (unverified); (7) config/strategies.yaml tp_r: 50.0 sentinels (TP doctrine, tp-doctrine-guard ratchet). The desk/live-review path is fixed in PRs #20412/#20414 (both_brackets_required refusal + read-back). Re-entry test: a runtime guard (CI + monitor probe) asserting every open leg carries a resting SL and TP at the venue, with each path above fixed or explicitly sanctioned by the operator. Rerun: grep -n 'tp=None' src/runtime/order_monitor.py; python3 scripts/ci/check_tp_doctrine.py. [2026-10-26 ~19:45Z lane LTR-ALL-ACTIONS] RE-VERIFIED by reading at main 577ed9c1 (MEASURED): execute.py:505-521 entry gate (both); prop_executor.py:364 ticket gate (both); prop_executor.py:3343-3345 naked check (TP required only when the journal has one); _repair_or_flatten is at prop_executor.py:2942 (not ~2939); order_monitor.py:13654 _check_naked_positions (SL or TP null); _attempt_naked_autoprotect is at order_monitor.py:9778 (not ~9827) - its both-levels-known gate NOT re-read; IB sweep order_monitor.py ~11693-11716 TP alert only when take_profit_1 declared; execute.py ~3246 eff_tp = tp if tp is not None else cur_tp, modify_protective via place_protective, symbol-wide without trade_id (~3292); ib_client.py ~1681/1690 places a TP/SL leg only when given; execute.py:1590-1595 Bybit spot carries no SL/TP; order_monitor.py:12244-12277 _bybit_top_up_partial_sl tp=None; _cancel_resting_protection_after_flat at order_monitor.py:2144 and _cancel_closed_row_protection at :2324 exist. NOT re-verified: the cancel-after-flat caller lines (4135, 7287, 7365, 8027, 8330, 15206, 4503/4800) and whether a wrong flat read can reach them; the Alpaca sweep (~10541) and the Bybit sweep (~12875) TP behaviour; protection_reassert.py beyond its STATE_NEEDS_BOTH_LEGS state (line 76). [2026-10-26 22:01Z lane IB-MGC-NAKED-REARM] IB lines RE-VERIFIED at main beb46d523 (MEASURED): the IB broker sweep (order_monitor._check_broker_naked_ib_positions) DID re-arm a stop-short book via _attempt_naked_autoprotect (stop AND TP, oca-protect-t<id>) but (a) graded a nothing-resting book as target_naked and counted naked=0, and (b) sized its foreign-target over-fill check on the JOURNAL row qty, so ib_paper/MGC (row 6673 = 14, broker short 12, no STP/LMT) read 0+14>12 and was never re-armed (fully naked from at least 18:43Z to ~21:04Z). FIXED: PR #20432 (merged beb46d523, deployed: trader_git_sha beb46d523; OBSERVED 21:55:18Z sweep 'covered=2 naked=0 target_naked=0'): nothing-resting => naked; counters before the guard; re-arm qty = min(row qty, broker size - stop cover) via qty_cap; a failed fully-naked re-arm pages (cooldown) and retries every sweep. The 'IB TP alert-only' line above still holds for a STOP-covered/target-missing book (attach-ib-target is the repair). REPAIR: new system-action rearm-ib-protective (PR #20431, merged 1ad340db) arms BOTH legs on a fully naked IB position (journal levels, broker qty, refuses if anything rests, read-back verified); applied #20442: MGC BUY STP 12 @ 4270.0 + BUY LMT 12 @ 3767.0 in oca-protect-t6673, venue_protection_snapshot measured 21:07:14Z, re-read 22:00:58Z still resting. Open residual filed: PI-20261026-CDTDGVDN-0001 (row 6673 journal 14 vs broker 12).
